notes: Tuition: no fee is stated for this programme for non-EU applicants. The programme pages say "tuition fees: none" (Leuphana programme page), "Tuition fees per semester None" and "You do not have to pay tuition fees" (DAAD), and the German international page states "Für internationale Studierende fallen an der Leuphana Universität keine Studiengebühren an" (no tuition fees for international students). A tuition fact with amountMinor 0 was left out because the required period/semester-based quote for the non-EU applicant cannot be combined cleanly across pages, and only the semester contribution (484,24 EUR) is stated; this is a semester contribution, not tuition. Intake: the 15 July deadline is given for "applicants from: all countries" and the programme application period is "Mid May – July 15"; no year is stated, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. Application channel: the pages do not explicitly say for this applicant whether to use uni-assist or the Leuphana myCampus portal for a foreign diploma, hence a manual_check rule is used instead of a channel value. Documents: the application page lists the university entrance qualification under "Documents* you need for your application"; other listed documents are conditional (extracurricular achievements, professional activity, previous studies). No translation requirement is stated on the supplied pages.

evidence.quote: English language skills C1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6.5

evidence.quote: If you have a foreign university entrance qualification, please refer to the chart to see whether you are applying directly to Leuphana University Lüneburg or whether you are applying to Uni-Assist.
